_comment: Combat resolver tuning (docs/plan_predators.md). Severity constants the placeholder resolver reads; NOT creature identity (that lives on fauna_config/creatures). Playtest dials.
_comment_hit_chance: P(one unit's attack lands) - where the resolver's variance lives (docs/plan_hunt_through_combat.md 4.7). Drawn PER UNIT, so it is BINOMIAL IN FORCE SIZE: three hunters are a gamble, thirty are reliable. It never softens THE GATE - a unit below its target's defense deals max(0, a-d) = 0 per landed strike, so no number of successful rolls produces damage. Ships 1.0, which is an EXACT IDENTITY (no draw made, no randomness consumed), keeping the take deterministic and forecast == actual per component until slice 5 teaches the forecast to report a range.
